title: Dizon tells new DPWH chief Lopez: ‘Pay close attention to Bulacan’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon on Tuesday asked Secretary Giovanni Lopez to closely monitor flood control projects and other developments in Bulacan as the latter assumes leadership of the agency. During a turnover ceremony of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), Dizon presented several unfinished flood control and other projects that were completed during his stint as DPWH secretary. He then noted that he discovered many incomplete flood control projects in Bulacan, some of which he earlier described as “ghost projects” because they were tagged as “complete” despite being fully funded.
